checks.title: Unused includes
checks.description: Find directly included C/C++ headers that provide no referenced declarations.

checks.title: Unused declarations
checks.description: Find unused using declarations and related compiler-proven local declarations.

checks.title: Dead stores
checks.description: Find assignments whose stored values cannot affect observable behavior.

checks.title: Unreachable code
checks.description: Find control-flow paths that static analysis proves cannot execute.

checks.title: Cross-translation-unit symbols
checks.description: Analyze whether internal and externally visible symbols are reachable across translation units.

checks.title: Discarded linker sections
checks.description: Inspect linker evidence for functions and data discarded from representative binaries.

checks.title: Unused dependencies
checks.description: Compare declared link dependencies with representative build and linker evidence.

checks.title: Orphaned files
checks.description: Compare maintained tracked files with their declarative build and validation ownership.

checks.title: Stale registrations
checks.description: Find registry entries whose declared repository targets no longer exist.

checks.title: Validation-only surfaces
checks.description: Identify hooks and platform paths that are reachable only from validation configurations.

explanations.reason: Public-header isolation translation units intentionally contain only the include boundary required to compile each public header independently.
